issues.on_page: Statement of Net Position - Cash Basis, September 30, 2025
issues.issue: The file is labelled FY2026 but covers the year ended 9/30/2025 (possibly the same year as an FY2025 filing). This is a possible wrong-year filing and is not in decision_needed (the extraction has no decision_needed list).

issues.on_page: Proceeds from long term debt 843,782 (p8, p13); Statement of Activities p2: Loan proceeds 506,269 plus Water capital grants and contributions 337,513
issues.issue: The report's own government-wide statement treats 337,513 of this money as a capital grant (possibly loan forgiveness), not debt. Which treatment applies needs a person; this is only mentioned in notes.

issues.on_page: Total Proprietary Funds column includes Apartment Fund 10,364 contractual, 6,686 utilities, 18,730 repairs, 5,149 other supplies, 24,890 capital outlay
issues.issue: The total-column lines mix housing (Apartments) with utilities, and everything is coded utilities. In detail the same Apartments lines are coded housing, so the two disagree. Defensible because the statement prints one total column, but no review flag is set on the lines.
Principal vs interest not printed; recorded as interest (review set). Same for detail[71].

issues.on_page: Debt service 107,650 (p11); statement p4 Debt Service Fund: Principal 95,000, Interest and other charges 13,050

The arithmetic holds and the value is marked computed, but it is an assumption. Also budget_final is null though the Debt service budget 108,050 is printed (applies to detail[47]).

issues.on_page: Police: Contractual and professional services 56,084; no personal services
issues.issue: A police department with no staff and one contract line is likely a sheriff contract, which would be 'law enforcement contract'.
There is a 'restricted assets' category for this; the choice is a judgment call.
